results.overview: A farmer's belly propels him into an extraordinary world, turning Homo Sapiens to Homo Umbilicus.

results.title: Aya Meets Ghosts
results.overview: Seven-year-old Aya is forced into an unexpected quest to survive, after everyone at her primary school believes she is haunted by jinn.

results.title: Indigo Elsewhere
results.overview: At the edge of an unnamed city, two unemployed, directionless trans lesbians connect in a reality-shifting way.

results.title: How to be a better serial killer
results.original_title: How to be a better serial killer
results.overview: It’s 2026, the job market is shit. Someone calls into a radio show, The Unemployment Line, where you can get tips on how to improve your skills and get help seeking a job. However, when a bizarre call throws the host off kilter, the unsuspecting host gives helpful tips and motivates an aspiring serial killer to achieve their dream Will the caller succeed, who will be their next victim?

results.title: In Transit
results.overview: A journey through leather, warmth and light, and the disembodied fear of catching the last train home. Our film has taken shape through a mix of live action, stop motion, and visual programming that connects the rural and the digital to form a journey in transit, flicking between both spatial planes in this search for home.

results.title: Drift
results.overview: Drift is an intimate exploration of what it means to be trapped in the sick body. This collaborative film tries to make the edges of the body visible and gesture towards the in-between state of sickness, loneliness and the domestic.

results.title: The Night
results.overview: Mika, a woman caring for her husband Anders who has Alzheimer’s, navigates her own loneliness and need for intimacy. When Ossian, a man working in home care, enters their lives, something is stirred in Mika – a reminder of her own vitality and desire, but also an uncomfortable truth about her situation.

results.title: Big Boys Don't Cry
results.overview: A camera enters the hypermasculine world of bouncers and bodybuilders in Cairo. Beneath the layers of performance and sculpted bodies, is it able to reach a core that is humane and vulnerable?

results.title: Something's in the Water
results.overview: A man enjoying his day in the park is interrupted by a seemingly lost little boy who is not what he seems to be.

results.title: Mustang
results.overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.

results.title: Gavin Matts: present
results.overview: A meditation on time and being alive, PRESENT is the follow-up comedy special to Gavin Matts: Progression (2023).

results.title: Freakshow
results.overview: While a group of mimes are getting ready for a performance, one of them reaches a breaking point.

results.title: Untitled Film Disinfection Project I
results.overview: As Borges once said, “Censorship is the mother of metaphor.” This 16mm structural film explores how state control breeds its own linguistic and visual resistance. Created in response to China's "zero-COVID" policy—with its harsh lockdowns, relentless testing, and severe restrictions that tragically culminated in the Ürümqi fire—this project treats developed image-less Ektachrome film as an "unclean" object in need of cleansing. By applying chlorine dioxide to film surfaces—following government disinfection guidelines during the pandemic—the work transforms physical material into a metaphor for censorship and information control in mainland China. Untitled Film Disinfection Project examines the delicate intersection of public health measures, state control, and artistic resistance.

results.title: Home
results.overview: A young woman studying far from home, faces heartbreak, she begins to feel lost in life.  She decides go back to home in the countryside make her know what is true love

results.title: She Looked Without Seeing
results.overview: Forget everything, or recover memory and remember. Let yourself fall and stop, or return to life and start again. Adrift, lost face-to-face, two women confront their fates. Is there not just one thing worth saving? Without hesitation, the desire to live, that rebellious fury that takes no heed of risks. And how do you save a world where poetry has disappeared?

results.title: Clayface
results.overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
